draw.method: eligible = candidate likely groups sorted by id, not _oem_held(cat, nissan); quotas by largest remainder (ties by cat name); per cat in sorted order rng.sample(ids, quota); pairs: rng.sample(remaining sorted ids, 30), then per group rng.choice(seeker vehicle-year), rng.choice(other vehicle-years) for donor

method: Own reader (scratch rawidx.py): product records indexed by part number (file:line), list-page rows by part number (file:line, row index), year pages by line. Evidence refs are 'file:line rN' = line N of that jsonl file, row index N in its rows array.

Own page of a vehicle-year = a list page of the group's category whose catalog slug is '<year>-<make>-<model>[-variant]'. Where that page is not in raw, the product record whose list_url is that vehicle-year's page (list_info = that page's row for the number) is used, with siblings read from a same-chassis page; noted per item.

Production dates are read per page: the same number carries different windows on different pages (80721-JK00A 11/2009-08/2010 on the 2009 G37 sedan page, 11/2009-06/2014 on the 2010 page; 96302-7S200 to 08/2005 on Armada, to 08/2006 on Titan), so a date on another vehicle's page does not override an undated own-page row.

Window rule (fixed before most items were read): a model year Y's builds are taken to run somewhere in 06/(Y-1)..09/Y. An ungated vehicle-year whose own page gives the number a window that cuts that span, with the same-option predecessor/successor listed, is RISK (window-edge). A window that cannot cover 11/(Y-1)..05/Y is cut deep inside the year: WRONG if the row is plain.

Option groups: the note 'option: fits some option packages' (or 'fits some configurations') is judged true when the siblings differ by trim/package codes; siblings with the same option clause are RISK only when some page shows a date split between them; any drive/engine/cab/body/trans word that separates siblings is checked against the gates.

Draw: Python random.Random(91371119); eligible = candidate likely groups sorted by id minus GROUP_HOLD_CATS (wiper-motor, 3 groups); largest-remainder quotas (window-regulator 18, side-mirrors 8, climate-control 3, gauge-cluster 1); pairs: 30 more groups, seeker and donor vehicle-years drawn from each group's apps. audit11_4/sample.py not used.

marks.mark: leading '*' on an option clause (e.g. '*W. AWD. BASE', '*CC. SE', '*S')
marks.claims_depending: G10 (and its left-hand twin 27714784b8): decides whether AWD base cars take 3JA9A or 3JN9x -> RISK. Elsewhere it only separates option variants inside an 'option' note (G01, G02, G03, G04, G08, G12, G27, G28, P10, P21, P25) and no gate depends on it.

marks.explained_by_pages: partly (federal / California emission spec, both always listed together)

marks.mark: body/cab codes T, KC, CC, W, S, SED, SEDAN, LSEDAN; bed SB, XB, STD/BED, LONG/BED
marks.explained_by_pages: by use (KC/CC match the crew/king-cab trims, W the Xterra/Armada wagon)
marks.claims_depending: G03 and P22 crew-cab gates (CC in every clause of the number's row)
none of the gates; G11/P10/P25 rows list both drives

marks.mark: trim/package codes SPORT/P, SPORTTEC, SPADTEC, TECHNOLO, ADVTECH, PREMITEC, SC, FLXFUEL, 5MT/6MT/5AT/AT
remarks LESS PAINT / PRIMER / BLACK / POWER/CRO / POWER/HEAT/MEM/CRO / F/AIR CONDITIONER LESS / WITHOUT AIRCON,ASCD & CASSETTE

window_edge class (ungated vehicle-year,.note: includes first/last model years (e.g. 1993 Altima 06/1992-08/1993) where the edge is the model's launch; the sampled RISK items G03, G08, G15, G16, G21, P03, P12, P30 are in this class

not_checked: _apply_oem_contradictions / the full lazy-file build were not run: 'shippable' = candidate likely groups outside GROUP_HOLD_CATS.

Only pfOemDonorGate (donor row verdict and warn line) and the group note were replayed; the seeker header line, radius, 'verified wins' and hand Likely rows of the full results loop were read in code, not executed.
Stanza vehicle-years have no lot cars (no US Stanza after 1992 in the feed), so their claims were checked on the pages only.

Own list pages not in raw (row seen only through the product record's list_info): Altima 1995 (no 1995 Altima year page at all), Frontier 2000 climate, Xterra 2004 climate, M35 2006 gauge, M37 2011 mirror, EX35 2008 / QX60 2014 / I30 2000 / Rogue 2016 window regulator.
Hybrid catalogs (QX60, Q70, Murano, Rogue) were never crawled; the gas gates rest on the year pages' variant lists.
suggestions: Gate Versa 2007 (and run the census window rule in curation): an ungated vehicle-year whose own-page window ends or starts deep inside the model year should get a built gate, as Murano 2005 did.
Say the door on cross-door groups (6 window-regulator groups): e.g. 'on the Versa this is the front right motor; on the Murano the rear right'. Or split them per position.

Treat the window edge consistently: FX35 2005 is gated on AR000-to-09/2004 but FX 2006 is not on CL70B-from-06/2006; M 2009 is gated on 06/2008 but M 2008 is not. Either gate both sides of a changeover month or neither, and write the choice down.
Read the '*' mark before using an AWD-worded sibling to keep a number plain (G10 pair of mirrors); until then show an 'AWD not checked' line.
Several groups are regulator MOTORS (Motor Assy-Regulator) in the window-regulator category; the row could say 'motor only'.
The raw has no 1995 Altima pages at all; a recrawl of that year would close several RISK/record-only claims.
